en.headline: Police investigate serving officer over viral Douyin video dancing in uniform
en.dek: The force confirmed the short-haired woman in the clip is an active officer, ordered the post removed and opened an internal inquiry into professional image and conduct.
body: Hong Kong police have launched an internal investigation into a serving female officer after a short video of her dancing in uniform circulated widely on the mainland Chinese platform Douyin.

In the 13-second clip the officer, whose shoulder identification numbers are covered, appears with a dog-ear filter and performs hand gestures to upbeat music. The post carried simplified-Chinese text about the heat and hashtags including references to cosplay and uniform fashion.

A police spokesman confirmed to media that the woman is a serving officer. The force said it values officers’ conduct and professional image, has directed her to take the video down, and will handle any breach of regulations solemnly.

zh.headline: 女警穿制服跳抖音片惹議 警方證實現役並內部調查
zh.dek: 警方確認短片中短髮女子為現役警務人員，已責成下架影片並展開內部調查，強調重視人員操守及專業形象。
body: 香港警方就一段在內地社交平台抖音流傳的短片展開內部調查。片中一名短髮女子身穿疑似香港警察制服，加上狗耳濾鏡隨音樂跳舞，肩章編號位置被遮蓋。
短片長約13秒，帖文以簡體字寫上「太熱了　給你扇扇風」，並附有cosplay及制服穿搭等標籤。有網民懷疑拍攝地點為警署，亦有人質疑行為有損公職人員形象。
警方回覆查詢時證實片中女子為現役警務人員，表示十分關注事件，已責成該人員將影片下架，並正就事件展開內部調查。警方強調一向重視警務人員的操守及形象，如發現任何違規行為定必嚴正處理。
